findings_resolved.finding: Managed daemon could restart after native START success but before wrapper health observation, and be adopted as initial anchor.
findings_resolved.resolution: Qualifier verifies native control receipt digest and passes transition.new_tree; root and managed daemon exact birth identities must be members.

findings_resolved.finding: Identity/CID reconstruction could cross the deadline after the last sampled clock, admitting late success.
findings_resolved.resolution: Final monotonic fence immediately precedes success; decoding-delay regression control covers this path.

limits: Polling decision is deadline checked; an individual observation is cooperative and may return after the deadline, in which case it cannot qualify.
Disposable runtime construction occurs before the START/polling deadline; STOP retains its separately bounded cleanup budget.
This empty nonimplementing lifecycle grants no task, proof, completion or production authority.
Focused native test results were still running at review time and are not claimed by this review.
method: Read-only source, control-owner, runtime-receipt and test review; no tests or native processes run by reviewer.
reviewed_contracts: Native START health receipt and control receipt each verify their CID before use.
Root identity matches native process_cid; managed daemon is a direct child and anchored by complete ProcessIdentity, not PID alone.
Missing/replaced root or daemon, extra root, foreign heartbeat owner, and heartbeat regression fail without reanchoring.
Auxiliary membership or unhealthy samples reset the 0.75-second healthy stability window.
Success requires a later native heartbeat than initial and stable-window baseline; native health owner checks wall-clock freshness.
START plus polling share the original qualification deadline. Slow observations or validation cannot report success after it.
STOP is attempted after qualification failures and success; successful result additionally requires old tree fenced and current tree absent.
Qualification receipt persistence or registry-close failure still reaches coordinator release after confirmed absent tree via nested finally.
